banner.title: Siyakuhlonipha ubumfihlo bakho
banner.text: Sisebenzisa ama-cookie nobuchwepheshe obufanayo. Ama-cookie adingekayo agcina isayithi isebenza. Ngemvume yakho, sisebenzisa nama-cookie ongawakhetha ezici, ukuhlaziya nokumaketha. Ungamukela konke, wenqabe konke, noma ukhethe ngesigaba ngasinye, futhi ushintshe umqondo wakho noma nini.

preferences.title: Okukhethwayo kwama-cookie
preferences.text: Khetha izigaba ezikhethwayo ozivumelayo. Ama-cookie adingekayo awakwazi ukuvalwa ngoba isayithi alisebenzi ngaphandle kwawo.

necessary.title: Adingekayo
necessary.description: Adingeka emisebenzini eyisisekelo efana nokuphepha, ukulinganisa umthwalo nokukhumbula lokhu okukhethiwe kwemvume.

functional.title: Asebenzayo
functional.description: Akhumbula okuncamelayo okufana nolimi noma isifunda futhi enza ukuthi izici ezifakiwe zisebenze.

analytics.title: Ukuhlaziya
analytics.description: Asisiza siqonde ukuthi isayithi lisetshenziswa kanjani ukuze silithuthukise.

marketing.title: Ukumaketha
marketing.description: Asetshenziselwa ukukala nokwenza izikhangiso zibe ngezomuntu ngamunye kuwo wonke amawebhusayithi.

blockedContent: Okuqukethwe kuvaliwe kuze kube yilapho uvumela isigaba esithi "{category}".
